commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text:
He goes on, to her friend.

I took shame and manliness as rafts to cross it. The fierce flood of desire tears them from me and carries them off. Other floods can’t do that, which is why he calls this one fierce. They are no rafts for this flood, and so they go.
